title: Add snippet test runner + mock server CI (optional staging checks)
author: Sahana Iyer
release_notes: Examples repo now runs snippet validation on every PR using a local mock Redwood API. A separate, rate-limited workflow can be run manually/nightly against staging using a restricted API key.
description: Context: We’ve had recurring drift where example snippets compile but don’t actually run (especially streaming finalization, partial tool args, and structured output validation/retry paths). This PR adds a lightweight snippet test runner to `redwood-examples` and wires it into GitHub Actions. The PR workflow runs everything against a deterministic local mock server (no secrets). A separate workflow can run against staging on a schedule or via manual dispatch with strict throttling to avoid rate-limit noise. Summary of changes: (1) Add `tools/snippet-test/` runner scripts and language targets (python/ts/go) with consistent env-based configuration. (2) Add `tools/snippet-test/mock-server/` (Node) with fixtures for non-streaming responses and streaming event lines, including partial tool-call argument deltas and both valid/invalid structured output payloads. (3) Add `.github/workflows/snippet-ci.yml` (PR + push) that starts the mock server on `127.0.0.1:4010`, waits for `/health`, then runs lint + examples in a matrix (python/ts/go). (4) Add `.github/workflows/snippet-staging.yml` (workflow_dispatch + nightly) that runs a small capped subset against staging using `REDWOOD_STAGING_SNIPPET_KEY`, with `SNIPPET_RPS=1`, `SNIPPET_MAX_CONCURRENCY=2`, `SNIPPET_MAX_TESTS=20`, and strict timeouts. (5) Add log redaction + guardrails: mock-mode never reads secrets, staging mode refuses to print headers/env, and the runner enforces a hard cap on retries to prevent runaway usage. Testing: verified locally on macOS + Ubuntu runner; validated that streaming fixtures include a terminal event and that tool-call JSON is emitted as multiple deltas so SDK example aggregators can’t regress silently. Notes: the mock server event shapes follow the canonical event taxonomy doc; if those shapes change, we should update fixtures and the examples together so CI catches drift. Follow-ups: once SDK repos adopt the same runner pattern, we can vendor the mock fixtures to reduce duplicated maintenance.
commits: tools/snippet-test: add runner entrypoint + env config (mode/mock|staging, timeouts, caps)
mock-server: add deterministic fixtures for streaming/tool-calls/structured-output + /health
ci: add snippet-ci workflow (mock-only) and snippet-staging workflow (rate-limited)
docs: update repo README with local run instructions + staging requirements
review_thread: Ibrahim Khan: Can we make sure the streaming fixtures include the same terminal event name we’re using in the canonical patterns doc? Right now I’m seeing `response.completed` in one fixture and `response.done` in another.

Sahana Iyer (author): Good catch. I pulled one fixture from an earlier draft. I’ll normalize everything to `response.completed` and add a test that fails if the stream doesn’t terminate within the per-example timeout.
Marcus Lin: Please confirm staging workflow doesn’t echo env vars on failure. Also ensure we never print Authorization headers (even redacted) in CI logs.

Sahana Iyer (author): Updated runner to explicitly redact `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and to avoid dumping request objects. Also changed error handler to print only status code + safe message (no headers/body) in staging mode.

Connor O'Brien: Rate limiting looks good, but GitHub Actions matrix might run in parallel and multiply request volume. Can we force staging workflow to run serially and add a concurrency group to prevent overlapping scheduled runs?

Sahana Iyer (author): Done: staging workflow is single job (no matrix), `SNIPPET_MAX_CONCURRENCY=2` inside runner, and added `concurrency: group: snippet-staging` with `cancel-in-progress: false` so we don’t overlap nightlies.
Sabrina James: Ran `./tools/snippet-test/run.sh python` locally; looks good. One nit: README should call out that mock server binds localhost and uses `REDWOOD_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4010`.
Sahana Iyer (author): Updated README with local quickstart + common failure mode notes (hang on streaming terminal event).
Allison Grant: +1 on the timeout defaults. Please keep job timeout <= 15 minutes for PR validation so hung streams fail fast.
Sahana Iyer (author): PR job `timeout-minutes: 15` and runner default `SNIPPET_TIMEOUT_MS=15000` in mock mode. Staging defaults to 30000ms.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash into main by Connor O'Brien
